build_fcos_head: build a python module to instantiate an FCOSHead for anchor-free object detection with configurable num_classes and in_channels
run_fcos_forward: run the FCOSHead forward pass on multi-scale FPN features to get cls_scores, bbox_preds, and centerness outputs
test_fcos_loss: test the FCOSHead loss_by_feat method with cls_scores, bbox_preds, centernesses, and ground truth instances
review_fcos_target_assignment: review the FCOSHead get_targets and _get_targets_single methods for positive sample assignment logic with center sampling and regress range filtering
refactor_fcos_centerness: refactor the FCOSHead centerness_target computation to calculate centerness from positive bbox targets using left-right and top-bottom ratios
